title: LLM Space: a desktop agent workbench for versioning prompts, replaying failed sessions step by step

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: LLM space is a desktop workbench for building agents when chat logs alone aren't enough to explain what went wrong. You can version prompts and tools, watch every model call and tool run, then replay failed sessions step by step. It also compares performance across runs and keeps threads as local files alongside your API keys. For agent builders, that keeps the whole debugging loop visible without scattering it across separate tools.
